script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let executer be the acting enemy of arg.
Let aiArg be the battle settings of the group of executer.
Let baseParam be executer → get-base-param.
If arg → get-condition-flag-in-frame with ("condition_flag_tag_black_magic_damage"), then
  Let v be the value "mdef" of baseParam.
  If 100 times (v minus the value "mdef" of executer) divided by v is at least the numeric entry "reduction_rate_of_mdef_not_showing_msg" in aiArg, then stop.
  Executer uses the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI immediately with options {sequence: [[{messageSuffixNo: "01"}]]} and timing {interruptBeforeCounter: true}.
Otherwise, if arg → get-condition-flag-in-frame with ("condition_flag_tag_physical_damage"), then
  Let v2 be the value "def" of baseParam.
  Let v3 be the value "def" of executer.
  Let v4 be 100 times (v2 minus v3) divided by v2.
  If v4 is at least the numeric entry "reduction_rate_of_def_not_showing_msg" in aiArg, then stop.
  Executer uses the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI immediately with options {sequence: [[{messageSuffixNo: "02"}]]} and timing {interruptBeforeCounter: true}.

script_hooks.logic:

Let v2 be v → to-string → substr with (the length of v → to-string minus 1).
Return _ → index-of with (each x in list2 mapped to x's 'paramSuffixNo', v2).

script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let executer be the acting enemy of arg.
Let hpRate be the HP fraction of executer.
Let v be call helper2 with (arg).
Let hpRate2 be the phase for executer under the phases list2 with HP fraction hpRate from phase v.
Let v2 be list2 at hpRate2.
Let paramSuffixNo be v2's 'paramSuffixNo'.
Let paramIdBySuffixNo be the stat block of form paramSuffixNo on executer.
If paramIdBySuffixNo is not the value "paramId" of executer, then
  Executer changes to stat block paramIdBySuffixNo.
  If paramSuffixNo is "3", then executer cancels its cast.
